request.objective: Start at https://www.discogs.com/. Open the page with an overview of the submission of releases on Discogs.

response.result:
Done — starting from discogs.com, the overview of submitting releases is now open:

**Overview Of Submission Guidelines For Releases**
https://support.discogs.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004016474-Overview-Of-Submission-Guidelines-For-Releases

On the site it sits under Discogs › Database & Contributing › Database Guidelines, and the page is credited to Discogs Community Support, March 31, 2026.

What the page holds:
- **Basic Guidelines** — the short list of essentials. Of those I can quote: have the exact release in front of you when entering it into the database; only enter or change information you can cite a trustworthy source for (stick to provable facts); make sure every artist and label you enter links to the correct page; and use the search to find Artist Name Variations. The list continues past that point and I did not capture the remaining bullets, so I won't guess at them.
- **Overview Of General Information** — the general database rules that follow on from the basics.
- **Full Guidelines** — the complete submission rules.
- **Still have questions?** — how to get in touch, plus a list of other articles in the section.

If you want the full wording of the Basic Guidelines list and of the sections below it, that would take another pass at the page.
